pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped sub-polygonal dark regions. Edges exhibit softened pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions. Patches on the shoulder and upper flank are larger and more elongated than the smaller, more densely packed patches on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial intersections. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly towards the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the upper neck mane. The silhouette is composed of short, dense bristles creating a consistent jagged edge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) perched on the dorsal midline; one is located on the upper neck/head region and the other on the shoulder. Pronounced horizontal cutaneous folds are visible on the ventrolateral aspect of the lower neck.
